title: Creative Studio
subtitle: Turn an idea or a long video into ready-to-post videos — AI writes, illustrates, narrates and renders.
selectProjectHint: Productions live inside a project. Pick one above to continue.
noProjectDesc: Create or pick a project first — every production belongs to one project.
emptyDesc: Pick a recipe above — Animated Explainer turns a topic into a finished video, Clip Factory cuts a long video into short clips.
emptyFilteredDesc: No jobs match this filter. Try another filter or create a new video.

catalog.title: What do you want to make?

catalog.documentaryDesc: Cited research + licensed stock footage assembled into a narrated montage.

wizard.hoverGuidePlaceholderDesc: Hover over a recipe card above to view input requirements, AI pipeline stages, and deliverables.
wizard.guideExplainerInput: Topic / Storyboard prompt (Text), target language, and intended audience.

wizard.guideClipInput: 1 existing long video (MP4, MOV up to 500MB).

wizard.guideDocInput: Topic research and copyright-cleared reference materials.
wizard.guideDocFlow: Cited research ➔ Rights discovery ➔ Documentary montage compose.
wizard.guideDocOutput: Documentary montage MP4 with provenance and copyright report.

errorCodes.BUDGET_HARD_CAP: The job's budget cap is too small for this step. Raise the cap or create a new job.
errorCodes.PRICING_ROW_MISSING: Pricing for a paid step is not configured yet — ask an admin to add it.
errorCodes.SCRIPT_INVALID: The script is invalid — check scene text and settings.
errorCodes.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: This action was already submitted with different data. Refresh and try again.
errorCodes.JOB_TERMINAL: This job already finished — it can no longer change.
errorCodes.STAGE_NOT_FAILED: Only failed steps can be retried.
errorCodes.NON_RETRYABLE_FAILURE: This failure cannot be retried automatically.
errorCodes.MAX_RETRY_EXCEEDED: Retry limit reached for this step.
errorCodes.PIPELINE_MISMATCH: This action belongs to a different pipeline.
errorCodes.RIGHTS_BLOCKED: A file without usage rights blocks rendering — replace it first.
errorCodes.QUALITY_BLOCKED: Quality checks blocked this render — fix the reported issues first.
errorCodes.MAX_CLIPS_PER_JOB_EXCEEDED: Too many clips requested for one job.
errorCodes.PRODUCTION_JOB_NOT_FOUND: Job not found in this workspace.
errorCodes.STORAGE_KEY_FORBIDDEN: This file does not belong to the job.
